architectural_constraints.requirement: Each product rule has one authoritative layer and other layers only reference its identity.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Parallel paraphrased ownership or semantic conflict resolution in the provider composer.

architectural_constraints.requirement: The Agent owns task semantics while Runtime enforces only mechanical state and graph invariants.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Runtime-selected goals, nodes, plans, initialization semantics, or next actions.

architectural_constraints.requirement: Tool results, failures, commit facts, and projections are transmitted faithfully.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Loss, distortion, duplicate wrapping, hidden failure, or next-step advice.

architectural_constraints.requirement: Content is assigned by stability and universal necessity.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Tool wire in Base, advanced playbooks in fixed context, or dynamic facts in stable instructions.

architectural_constraints.requirement: Ordinary Tools describe only their native capability, success, inputs, outputs, and side effects while taskspace_control exclusively describes Map actions.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: TaskSpace binding or response-sequencing fields on ordinary Tools, planning instruction, or semantic inference.

architectural_constraints.requirement: Base, protocol, and Tool schema bytes stay fixed inside one immutable capability epoch.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Schema changes triggered by Map revision, empty state, or lifecycle state.

architectural_constraints.requirement: The three projection policies share L1 through L4, Map, Runtime, feedback, and state machine.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Policy-specific architecture or behavior branches outside L5 emission.

architectural_constraints.requirement: One Agent-authored rooted DAG has one Root, one explicit Finish, full reachability, and Agent-authored terminal closure.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Orphan nodes, Runtime-authored task topology, automatic Finish, or a second canonical state.

architectural_constraints.requirement: Initialization and every nonterminal Map mutation carry one or more Agent-declared node actions and matching native sibling Tool calls in the same complete response.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Standalone nonterminal Map mutation, action-manifest mismatch, or ordinary Tool content inspection to infer sequence validity.

architectural_constraints.requirement: Patch input remains native top-level text and at most one Patch executes per response.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Nested Patch transport, multi-Patch partial writes, or blocking a valid control plus Patch pair.

architectural_constraints.owner: provider Tool visibility and sequence runtime
architectural_constraints.requirement: Shared ordinary Tool schema, arguments, and native execution remain identical in Standard and TaskSpace while bundled Skills remain shared.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Ordinary Tool decoration, wrapping, Standard Tool mutation, or benchmark-only Skill disabling.

architectural_constraints.requirement: Preflight failure is zero-dispatch and zero-commit and each failure has one factual result.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Argument repair, semantic retry, duplicate failure envelopes, or failure hiding.

architectural_constraints.requirement: Per-request and aggregate Tool bytes, tokens, cache, requests, and time are measured.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Correctness-only promotion or unmeasured permanent schema amplification.

architectural_constraints.requirement: One strategy changes per experiment under identical artifacts and simple plus complex samples.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Confounded arms, excluded Agent errors, or infrastructure failures counted as behavior.

architectural_constraints.requirement: Schema, parser, tests, logs, and docs migrate atomically without legacy data compatibility.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Old wire fallback, dual parser, silent compatibility branch, or undocumented drift.

architectural_constraints.requirement: Root, work_nodes, and Finish roles that drive parsing or hard validation are represented by distinct Tool fields or schema branches, with multiple initial work nodes allowed.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Erasing roles into a generic collection, relying on cross-field prose, or restoring a singular initial/current work cursor.

architectural_constraints.owner: persistent Map Store and L5 Runtime
architectural_constraints.requirement: One independently persisted Map Store is the canonical owner; sessions and Runtime use identity handles or disposable revision-checked caches.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Session-local authoritative Map copies, rollout checkpoint or delta recovery authority, silent Map reconstruction, or dual sources of truth.

architectural_constraints.owner: Agent action manifest and L5 dispatcher
architectural_constraints.requirement: The Agent explicitly declares node_id for every ordinary Tool call in the same response manifest and one response may advance multiple nodes.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Runtime-inferred, defaulted, repaired, or selected action ownership, or node metadata exposed to native ordinary Tool handlers.

architectural_constraints.requirement: The Store persists nonredundant dependency, completion, block, action-reservation, result, and revision facts from which lifecycle views are derived.
architectural_constraints.prohibited: Persisted Open, canonical current_node/current_binding/next_node, singleton main lease, or any second lifecycle fact source.

regression_invariants.problem: The Whale minimal Base discarded the mature Codex engineering framework.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Standard and TaskSpace each select one complete Codex-derived Base.

regression_invariants.problem: TaskSpace appeared only as scattered low-salience developer text.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: L1 owns the macro model and L2 owns the normal working protocol without duplication.

regression_invariants.problem: Docker benchmarks disabled bundled Skills and changed the product capability set.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Standard and TaskSpace use the same bundled Skills infrastructure.

regression_invariants.problem: L2 recovery depended on Tool result fields that were not visible to the Agent.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: All control entry paths return factual TaskSpaceControlResultV2 fields.

regression_invariants.problem: The observer underreported preflight rejects, handler attempts, gates, and commits.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Preflight, handler, gate, and commit telemetry are independently countable.

regression_invariants.problem: A nested transition discriminator caused lifecycle action and parser drift.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Lifecycle operations use direct top-level action variants.

regression_invariants.problem: Initialization success omitted action-attribution facts.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Initialization result reports Agent-declared action attribution, reservation, and commit facts explicitly.

regression_invariants.problem: A single control schema cannot require a top-level real Tool sibling.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: A complete response passes Tool type, order, and count preflight before any client Tool executes.

regression_invariants.problem: Missing ordinary Tool attribution silently drifted to the wrong node.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Missing, extra, or mismatched action attribution fails zero-dispatch preflight and is never inferred, defaulted, repaired, or silently drifted.

regression_invariants.problem: Standalone complete or bind was rejected only after an extra provider request.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: A nonterminal boundary and its real successor occur in one response under zero-dispatch response grammar and natural runs do not stably amplify requests through recovery.

regression_invariants.problem: Early or ambiguous terminal actions selected the wrong Finish path.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: One finish_map action accepts the Agent terminal choice and validates the canonical frontier.

regression_invariants.problem: Nested Patch JSON was malformed or multiple Patches partially wrote a response.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Patch remains native top-level text and one response executes at most one Patch.

regression_invariants.problem: TaskSpace decoration modified ordinary Tools in Standard.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Shared ordinary Tools keep byte-identical native schema and execution paths in Standard and TaskSpace.

regression_invariants.problem: Preflight and router wrapped the same undispatched failure twice.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: An undispatched Tool call produces one factual failure result.

regression_invariants.problem: Uncarriable provider-native Tools or incomplete Tool responses could enter execution.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Incomplete responses neither execute nor persist, and capabilities that cannot enter a complete client manifest are explicitly classified before a product visibility decision.

regression_invariants.problem: A full lifecycle union was copied onto every ordinary Tool.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Response grammar is not copied onto ordinary Tools and the central control exclusively owns Map actions.

regression_invariants.problem: Map initialization consumed a standalone provider request before real work.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: initialize_map and at least one native ordinary Tool occur in the same response and execute in barrier order.

regression_invariants.problem: A mixed scalar-or-object binding union biased generation toward the wrong short branch.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Ordinary Tool binding is removed and the central control uses direct action variants.

regression_invariants.problem: Initialization graph and binding schema are copied onto ordinary Tools and the current Tool section remains 46926 bytes per request.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Shared ordinary Tool bytes equal Standard and TaskSpace fixed overhead comes only from the single central control and explicit capability-set differences.

regression_invariants.problem: A compact nodes plus role-id initialization wire erased Root, Work, and Finish role structure and caused repeated invalid initialization.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Keep Root, work_nodes, and Finish structurally distinct while allowing multiple initial work nodes in one fixed Agent-authored initialization contract.

regression_invariants.problem: A node-bound TaskSpace subagent spawn restores an inconsistent assignment from the parent rollout and fails before the child session starts.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: A subagent accesses the same persisted canonical Map by identity and distinguishes child attachment from TaskSpace session resume without reconstructing the Map from rollout.

regression_invariants.problem: Map-request complex runs repeatedly generate multiple sibling Patch calls or postpone Map lifecycle bookkeeping until after business work.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: Promotion evidence shows no repeated multi-Patch protocol rejection or post-hoc Map closure pattern while preserving one-Patch atomic safety and Agent-owned lifecycle choices.

regression_invariants.problem: The canonical Map is owned by Session-local Runtime state and recovered by replaying rollout checkpoints and deltas.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: One independently persisted Map Store remains the canonical data owner; Runtime, sessions, resumes, forks, and child agents access it by identity while rollout remains audit and context history only.

regression_invariants.problem: A singleton current_node/current_binding/main lease reduces the multi-active-node DAG to a Runtime-driven linear cursor.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: The Agent declares node_id per ordinary action, Runtime keeps no current or next node, and one response can advance multiple declared nodes.

regression_invariants.problem: Persisted Open duplicates dependency, block, in-flight, and completion facts and creates a second lifecycle source.
regression_invariants.required_behavior: The Store persists only nonredundant facts and deterministically derives Waiting, Ready, InFlight, Blocked, Completed, and open-node metrics.

candidate_gates.requirement: Agent retains all graph and task semantic choices.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Source boundary review and initialization wire fixture.

candidate_gates.requirement: Tool schema is byte-identical across Map states in one capability epoch.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Empty and initialized state schema hash test.

candidate_gates.requirement: Initialization and every nonterminal Map mutation stay in one response with one or more real actions.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Response grammar matrix and provider trace.

candidate_gates.requirement: Shared ordinary Tools contain no TaskSpace fields and are byte-identical across Standard and TaskSpace.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: JSON schema golden, wire hash, and source residue scan.

candidate_gates.requirement: Feedback preserves initialization, business, and commit outcomes separately.
Native top-level single Patch behavior is unchanged.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Patch fidelity, multi-Patch reject, and control-plus-Patch tests.

candidate_gates.requirement: Standard Tool bytes and execution path are unchanged.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Standard schema snapshot and paired smoke.

candidate_gates.requirement: All three projection policies share L1 through L4 behavior.
TaskSpace Tool section is below the current 46926 bytes per request and shared ordinary Tool overhead is zero.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Provider wire trace with per-Tool bytes and estimated tokens.

candidate_gates.requirement: Simple and complex behavior does not add known regressions.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Docker repeat runs with request-level trace audit.

candidate_gates.requirement: Schema, response manifest, preflight, barrier, dispatch, and commit remain observable.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Telemetry contract tests and observer reconciliation.

candidate_gates.requirement: No taskspace_binding, initialization carrier, legacy parser, or fallback remains.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Source scan and negative old-wire test.

candidate_gates.requirement: Root, work_nodes, and Finish initialization roles remain structurally distinct and multiple initial work nodes are valid.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Schema inspection, one-pass multi-work fixture, role-collision negatives, and Docker initialization traces.

candidate_gates.requirement: TaskSpace subagent handoff and replay do not persist or restore an inconsistent assignment intermediate state.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Focused failing spawn regression, parent-child handoff fixture, resume/fork regression, and typed boundary telemetry.

candidate_gates.requirement: Natural complex runs do not repeatedly reach response-wide multi-Patch rejection or defer Map lifecycle bookkeeping until after business work.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Per-policy multi-Patch attempt, zero-dispatch reject, lifecycle cadence, request path, and final Map closure evidence.

candidate_gates.requirement: The canonical Map survives process restart, resume, fork, child attachment, and rollout truncation through one independently persisted identity.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Map Store integration tests, failure injection, same-map revision traces, rollout truncation negatives, and source scan proving no rollout recovery fallback.

candidate_gates.requirement: Every native ordinary Tool call matches one Agent-declared node_id plus Tool name in response order.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Multi-node action-manifest fixtures, count/name/order negatives, raw Tool-result attribution, and zero-dispatch mismatch tests.

candidate_gates.requirement: Production model, Runtime, projection, event, subagent, and Tool contract contain no canonical current, next, bind, handoff, or singleton main-lease semantics.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Repository residue scan, multi-Ready and multi-InFlight property tests, and same-response multi-node execution trace.

candidate_gates.requirement: Open is not persisted and all lifecycle views are derived deterministically from one set of Store facts.
candidate_gates.evidence_required: Store schema inspection, property/replay equivalence tests, restart round-trip, and open-state residue scan.

rejected_directions.direction: Change ordinary Tool schema when the Map becomes initialized.
Let Runtime create task nodes, goals, edges, or choose the next node.
Allow central initialize_map to succeed without a following ordinary Tool in the same response.
Add any TaskSpace binding or lifecycle union to ordinary Tools.
Wrap native Tools in a generic nested dispatcher.
Infer or synthesize action ownership from ordinary Tool arguments, a Store current pointer, Tool content, or heuristic defaults.
Use prompt text without response-level preflight as the only initialization or continuity contract.
Relax graph, revision, action-attribution, reservation, or terminal invariants for pass rate.
Inject corrective next-action advice into failure feedback.
Flatten Root, Work, and Finish into a generic nodes collection plus role-id references to save bytes.
Reconstruct the canonical Map from session rollout checkpoints or deltas, or retain a Session-local authoritative Map copy.
Maintain a singleton current binding, next node, or main lease and attribute ordinary actions through that Runtime-owned cursor.
Persist Open or any lifecycle state that can be deterministically derived from the same canonical facts.
